scope: Adversarially test the supposed terminal disposal of the 1960 Teachers' Organization Bill by tracing National Archives cabinet metadata after the May 16 coup; preserve bill-identity uncertainty and avoid equating same-title records without text comparison.

breakthrough.finding: The National Archives cabinet-record search independently indexes both '교육공무원법중 개정법률(제25회)' and '교직단체법(제25회)' with deliberation date 1961-06-21. This is after the May 16 coup and conflicts with treating the later-synthesis statement that the Chang Myon government's Teachers' Organization Bill was '폐기' on 1961-02-12 as the terminal end of the title/legislative lineage.
breakthrough.caution: The 1961 record does NOT yet prove that the June military-government bill is textually identical to, revived from, or legally continuous with the 1960-10-08 item 288. Same title plus the paired Education Public Officials Act amendment is a high-value continuity signal, not identity proof.

adversarial_checks: Do not treat KDemo's 1961-02-12 '폐기' statement as terminal without an official disposal record.
Do not infer that the 1961-06-21 same-title bill is identical to the 1960 bill.
Do not infer military-government adoption or enactment merely from cabinet-record indexing/deliberation.
Do not attribute the June 1961 bill personally to Minister Mun Hui-seok without proposal/signature/minutes evidence.
Do not treat paired Education Public Officials Act amendments in 1960 and 1961 as companion measures until texts are compared.
Test whether National Archives metadata could represent a later filing/carry-over rather than a newly drafted bill.
Search for promulgation/non-promulgation evidence in official gazette and statutes to distinguish deliberation from enactment.
Compare post-coup dissolution/arrest policy toward teachers unions with the bill's institutional purpose rather than assuming a single policy logic.
Separate continuity of document title, continuity of text, continuity of policy objective, and continuity of legal authority.
Preserve the 1961-02-12 claim as CONFLICTED/NARROWED rather than silently overwriting it.
